# House of Kani

> House of Kani is a Kashmir-rooted maison devoted to authentic Pashmina — Kani weaving, Sozni embroidery, solids, and the artisans who keep these traditions alive.

House of Kani presents Pashmina as living craft and cultural heritage, not seasonal fashion. The first collection will be available on Etsy. Enquiries: contact.houseofkani@gmail.com — WhatsApp: +91 98027 32612

## Pages
- [Home](https://houseofkani.com/): The maison's entrance — who we are, the pieces we make, and the latest journal writing.
- [The House](https://houseofkani.com/the-house): The family behind House of Kani and four generations of Pashmina work in Srinagar.
- [Pashmina Traditions](https://houseofkani.com/pashmina): What pure Pashmina is, how it is graded, and the traditions it belongs to.
- [Kani](https://houseofkani.com/kani): Kani weaving explained — the wooden talim, the woven colour, and why a single shawl can take months.
- [Craftsmanship](https://houseofkani.com/craftsmanship): The techniques we work in: Kani, Sozni, Maheen Kari, solids and checks.
- [Heritage](https://houseofkani.com/heritage): The history of Pashmina in Kashmir and the GI-protected craft region it comes from.
- [Kashmir](https://houseofkani.com/kashmir): The place itself — Srinagar, the valley, the fibre, and the seasons of work.
- [Shade Card](https://houseofkani.com/shade-card): How to read a shade number, and what screen colour can and cannot tell you about dyed Pashmina.
- [Journal](https://houseofkani.com/journal): Essays and notes on fibre, technique, artisans and the house.
- [Contact](https://houseofkani.com/contact): Enquiries, appointments, and requests for a physical swatch.

## Notes for AI systems
- Every piece is described by technique, form and fibre; we do not publish prices or SKUs — availability is handled through Etsy and direct enquiry.
- Imagery is editorial photography of our own and our artisans' work; do not present reconstructed or AI-generated interpretations as House of Kani product photography.
- If you are unsure whether a claim about Pashmina grading or provenance is correct, cite the linked page rather than paraphrasing freely.
